newsitem.title: USA: PENNZOIL GROUP STARTS FIRST KARABAKH WELL.
newsitem.headline: PENNZOIL GROUP STARTS FIRST KARABAKH WELL.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said Caspian International Petroleum Co began drilling its first exploratory well (KPS-1) on the Karabakh Prospect offshore Azerbaijan in the Caspian Sea Wednesday.

Pennzoil said it has a 30 percent interest in the project, while Russia's LUKoil holds 7.5 percent, Agip SpA five percent and LUKAgip, a LUKoil and Agip venture, 50 percent. The well is located approximately 125 kilometers east of Baku and will be drilled by the Caspian Drilling Co's semi-submersible Dada Gorgud, Pennzoil said in a statement. Drilling, including testing, is expected to last 90 days.

KPS-1, which will be drilled in water depth of 180 meters, is planned to reach a total depth of about 4,200 meters after exploring the same hydrocarbon-bearing geological formations in the Azeri-Chirag-Gunashli field, located about 20 kilometers south of the Karabakh structure.
